title: UTC-day opening-range breakout on 15m, wide ranges only, midpoint stop and time exit
rule_summary: 15m closed candles, UTC clock; signal at bar close, order at next bar open. Each UTC day, the opening range is the highest high and lowest low of the four 15m bars from 00:00 to 01:00 UTC. The day is armed only if (range high - range low)/range low >= 0.8%. ENTRY: between 01:00 and 12:00 UTC, the first 15m close above the range high, if flat and no trade yet today (one trade per day per pair). EXIT, first of: 15m close below the range midpoint; 15m close >= range high + 1.5 x range height (profit target); 20:00 UTC bar close (time exit). No re-entry the same day. No trend filter.
mechanism: Overnight/early-session range compression is followed by a directional move when the first participants of the Asian-to-Europe handover (stops, breakout buyers, momentum chasers) hit the book; late sellers who fade the range are forced to cover or chase. The width filter keeps the range at 0.8% or more, so a 1.5x range-height target is a move well above the 0.35% round-trip cost; the midpoint stop caps the loss at about half a range. Source gives the generic ORB rule and no crypto mechanism; this is the closest honest one.
